denial.reason_text: Non-covered: advanced imaging at an out-of-network freestanding facility is excluded under this plan.

triage.explanation: Service excluded or not covered by the plan. The plan excludes this service, so medical-necessity evidence won't change the outcome. Explain the exclusion to the patient and check whether another payer or a covered alternative applies.

deadline.basis: Internal appeal: At least 180 days after receipt of the adverse determination; counted from the notice date to be safe. The plan may allow longer. Enrollee appeal window. Contracted providers' payment disputes with a Medicare Advantage plan follow the provider contract; check the denial notice.
